title: Coordinate conditional variance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and choose a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and an input $x\in\Omega^n$. The conditional variance of $f$ when coordinate $i$ is resampled from $\pi$, with the other coordinates fixed at $x$, is the $\pi$-expectation of the squared deviation from the corresponding conditional mean.
